zh: 短假期看核心景点
天门山、袁家界、天子山，加黄龙洞与大峡谷
返程日的游览按航班时间安排
en: Core sights in a short stay
Tianmen, Yuanjiajie and Tianzi, plus the cave and canyon
Departure-day sightseeing depends on your flight

zh: 多一天走山间溪谷
在精华4天路线中增加黄石寨与金鞭溪一天
黄石寨往返索道，金鞭溪按体力确定步行长度
en: An extra day for peaks and trails
Adds Huangshizhai and Golden Whip Stream to the core four-day route
Return cableway and a stream walk adjusted to your fitness

ko: 부용진 오후 출발·야경 후 장가계 귀환
같은 4박 5일 산수 코스의 황석채·금편계 하루를 부용진으로 바꾼 구성
zh: 山景加瀑布古镇夜景
袁家界、天门山、黄龙洞、大峡谷，加芙蓉镇
下午出发去芙蓉镇，看完夜景返回张家界
同为5天，将山水线的黄石寨、金鞭溪一天换为芙蓉镇
en: Mountain sights and waterfall lights
Yuanjiajie, Tianmen, cave and canyon, with Furong Town
Afternoon departure for Furong, returning after the night views
Uses the Huangshizhai and stream-walking day of the five-day mountain route for Furong instead

ko: 황석채 관광 뒤 오후는 호텔에서 휴식
zh: 黄石寨与芙蓉镇，留出休息时间
黄石寨索道与观景步道，加芙蓉镇瀑布夜景
黄石寨游览后，下午回酒店休息
en: Huangshizhai, Furong and time to rest
Huangshizhai cableway and viewpoints, plus Furong night views
An afternoon at the hotel after Huangshizhai

ko: 장가계 관광 후 고성 골목·강변 산책과 야간 유람선
마지막 밤은 봉황 숙박·다음 날 공항 직행
zh: 在凤凰古城住一晚
张家界游览后，逛古城街巷、河岸，夜游沱江
最后一晚住凤凰，次日本团车辆直接送机场
en: A night in Fenghuang Old Town
Zhangjiajie sights followed by old-town lanes and a river night cruise
Final night in Fenghuang, then a direct airport transfer

zh: 短假期的山间徒步
袁家界、天子山，加黄石寨与金鞭溪步行
晚到方案不含黄龙洞与大峡谷
en: A short mountain walking trip
Yuanjiajie and Tianzi, plus Huangshizhai and Golden Whip Stream
Late-arrival plans exclude the cave and canyon

ko: 연속 걷기 일정·늦은 도착은 황룡동·대협곡 제외
zh: 增加七星山的一天徒步
黄石寨、金鞭溪之外，再走七星山观景步道
连续步行日程，晚到方案不含黄龙洞与大峡谷
en: An extra walking day on Qixing Mountain
Huangshizhai and Golden Whip Stream, plus Qixing viewpoints
Consecutive walking days; late-arrival plans exclude cave and canyon

ko: 부용진은 오후 출발·야경 관람 후 장가계 귀환
zh: 徒步加芙蓉镇夜景
黄石寨、金鞭溪、七星山，加瀑布古镇夜景
下午去芙蓉镇，夜景结束后返回张家界
en: Mountain walks and Furong by night
Huangshizhai, Golden Whip Stream and Qixing, plus waterfall lights
Visit Furong in the afternoon and return to Zhangjiajie after dark
